classification: Design assumptions and calculations, not bank observations; M05 unchanged.
currency: R; R_to_C=1; RUB conversion is scenario procurement cost, not cash redemption
eligibility: All staff incl HR/managers in objectively defined comparable role/task strata with independent logs; no prescreening by expected success. Exposure conditions affect qualified result, not financing denominator. Four rights/year per employee maximum; all7200 reserved.

lower_tier.qualification_rule: concept.md section2; every qualifying employee receives500, no places/lottery

contests.groups: Design:180 comparable strata x40; fund invariant for arbitrary group sizes with sum n_g<=7200. Groups stay inside department; no cross-profession raw KPI ranking.
contests.group_pool_R_cycle_formula: 62.5*n_g; nominal40 gives2500R. n_g includes all eligible before success, not only applicants.
contests.tie_rule: Split sum of occupied tied prize slots equally among tied employees; ties spanning unpaid boundary split only paid slots; no added funds. Round down to whole R, residue unissued.
contests.small_groups: n=1 no top opponent: top unissued; n=2+ same pool rule; unpublished personal statements. No group pool reallocation after effort.
contests.team_rule: Operational team mode if individual attribution unsafe: team fund <=62.5*n_members, 80/20 by team ranks, shares fixed by contracted FTE before period; all team shares together <=group pool. One membership for one result; cross-department fund portions sum once. Individual baseline500 only once per person/cycle.

special.approval: Other authorized benefit owner verifies ID, actual outcome and quality; other HR posts. Manager own contribution: peer/executive outside recipient reporting dependency; HR own: nonrecipient HR deputy + business benefit owner. Named alternate; recipient cannot pick amount or exception.
special.scarcity: Finite recognition, no guarantee for all special nominations. Ready verified records ordered by confirmation timestamp then benefitID; published remaining fund. Same-value tied timestamp divides remaining slot without enlarging fund; no earned award revoked.

stacking.special_plus_regular: Only distinct benefitID or independently evidenced incremental benefit excluded from ordinary metric; same benefit cannot be paid in two channels. Fallback not a second base.
stacking.maximum_formula: base2000 + top10000 + special15000=27000/person/year. Any excess top share unissued; whole fund reserve does not rely on cap savings.
stacking.salary_KPI: Good work within duties can qualify; performance bonus already paying same benefit is declared. If monetary duplicate exists no special award; ordinary recognition is announced as distinct small recognition, no salary bonus formula altered.

rights_calendar.cohorts: 3 equal administrative calendars of2400, 4 rolling90-day observations/person/year. Everyone eligible every quarter; cohorts are not competitive admission or annual rotation. Cohorts set before effort, equal exposure rules. Prelaunch90-day observation after rules published; operating-year model includes full12 months of rights. Startup cannot claim faster accrual.
rights_calendar.earned: Observation closes15th; quality/reopen window ends29th -> confirmed right29th. Data posting by next working day; requests and immediate certificate access after posting, merch <=30days when preordered. Dates are proposed service standards.
rights_calendar.unposted_control: At delay keep confirmed rights U separate from F; no expiration, reserve includes U once. Contingency signed dated claim and authorized alternative posting, no conversion of old earned rights into next-quarter F.

expected_award_flow_not_M05.note: Process demand forecast only. M05 EXPECTED redemption still funds/issues maximum16.8mR and uses new_R_use100%; no guarantee financed by nonparticipation.

workload.employee_useful_work_note: Ordinary paid work is not invented incremental labor. Actual useful work hours measured in pilot; process hours above never substitute for useful work.

prelaunch_hours.schedule: Two months before operating year: half each month; separate90-day observation after announcement. These hours added to year1resource cost, not omitted.

all_eligible_requests_peak.capacity: Fail220. Not promised staffed capacity; preserves earned ordinary rights, no contingent special reward promised to every nomination.

workload.capacity: Combined with common M05 HR220h/month. Regional1800/1200 baskets unchanged. Manager/employee/IT available hours unknown: numeric requirement is not evidence of capacity.

data_requirements: Immutable exported assignment, taskclass, actual available exposure and completion/quality logs; assumed source not confirmed API.
Freeze complexity weights and role benchmark before period; archive query version, hash and full denominator.
Independent data owner approves corrections with before/after, reason, timestamp; recipient cannot confirm own logs.
Monthly crosscheck 10% records + all exceptions, sample independence and delayed defects; external to subject manager if subject is manager/HR.

If historical log absent: prospectively signed register for whole period with independent owner and QA; no unsupported metric earns right, no discretionary replacement. Bank data failure preserves proved or reconstructible earned right.
no_self_award_controls: Self nomination allowed as factual report only, no rate/level choice.
Automatic formula runs from other-owned locked data; dual control on recipient-admin own data and posting.
No ad hoc recipient exception; future rules approved by methodology owner and independent HR. Named deputies for conflict or absence.

M05_checks.note: E12/24/36 are common scale controls; actual candidate max16.8m, invalid within E12. They are not altered lower-tier promises. Actual guarantee only selectedE24 with16.8m allocation before effort. No financial self-admission; independent finance check required.

full_new_synchronous_quarter_peak.note: Extra FULL_NEW check; frozen QUARTER_END_R uses expected fixed60%, not full-new. Rights not delayed into a queue.

ordinary_formula.baseline: 12weeks full history; same reference/weights, fixed2cycles; Bstar=max(B,0.95)
ordinary_formula.growth: B<1.15: Q>=1 and Q/Bstar-1>=0.05 =>500R; top growth>=0.10 ranked rounded G to0.001
ordinary_formula.no_base: current Q>=1 and minimum observations=>500R; top Q>=1.10 rankedQ

operational_metrics_assumptions.reference: Frozen12week role median standardized_units/available_hour, fixed annual role complexity/channel/shift weights; no employee-selected denominator
